I re-derived the schedule from the constraints, and it's the same as before. The team note is wrong.

Hana's slot must be 6. Gus, Ben and Cara all come before Hana, so Hana is at least slot 4. Slots 4, 7 and 8 each fail once Cara, Gus and Dev's distance constraints are applied, and slot 9 would put Finn in slot 10. Slot 5 fails too: it forces Ann into slot 4 or 8, and that breaks Dev's distance constraints. With Hana in slot 6, the only valid arrangement is Gus in 4, Ann in 5, Ben in 2, Cara in 1, Elif in 3, Finn in 7, Ivo in 8 and Dev in 9.

The team note says Ann takes slot 4 and Gus takes slot 5. That can't work. Ann in 4 would require Hana in slot 5 (Finn is two slots from Ann), and Hana in 5 has no valid arrangement. Gus in 5 with Ann in 4 also fails the same way.

I checked all 17 constraints against this order and each holds:
- Finn (7) is right after Hana (6).
- Elif (3) and Ivo (8) are 5 apart.
- Cara (1) and Gus (4) are 3 apart.
- Dev (9) and Elif (3) are 6 apart.
- Cara (1) is before Hana (6), Ann (5), Finn (7) and Dev (9).
- Ann (5) and Dev (9) are 4 apart.
- Dev (9) and Gus (4) are 5 apart.
- Exactly one person (Hana) is between Ann (5) and Finn (7).
- Ben (2) and Finn (7) are 5 apart.
- Gus (4) is before Hana (6).
- Ben (2) is before Elif (3), Dev (9) and Gus (4).
- Dev (9) and Hana (6) are 3 apart.
- Cara (1) and Dev (9) are 8 apart.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Cara","2":"Ben","3":"Elif","4":"Gus","5":"Ann","6":"Hana","7":"Finn","8":"Ivo","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
